package: W145-01 — AbovePrompt pane layout and key core
question: Which part of the never-ported AbovePrompt pane can land as a pure, testable slice, and what does it compute?
answer: Eleven blocks (1,473 UTF-16 units) carry the pane's pure core: the window/cue computation, autofocus index, Input/Select key-context naming, hotkey map, cue fully-laid-out check, plugin overlap check, pane key merge, six scroll handlers, the yoga absolute-top walk, and the two constants (5 collapse columns, 150 ms settle debounce). The React component NFe remains the next slice; these blocks import nothing and are exercised through test/plugin-chain-above-prompt.test.ts.

components.note: NFe [456049,461905) is the renderer-facing component and the next slice; measured at 5,856 units with 82 unresolved names, so it was not forced into this package

behavior.window: yne clamps the budget at 0; the tree overflows only when treeRows exceeds that budget; on overflow one row is reserved for the cue and maxOffset is treeRows minus the window; bodyRows is settledBudget minus 1, floored at 0
behavior.autofocus: kne returns null only for an empty list, otherwise the first isAutoFocus index or 0
behavior.contextName: NI maps an Input tag to AbovePromptInput and a Select tag to AbovePromptSelect, else the caller's fallback
behavior.hotkeys: G1 collects hotkey->press from every Button that has a hotkey, then stops at Buttons (no recursion into them) and skips engine subtrees; string children are ignored
behavior.cueLayout: Tne is true without a cue; with a cue it is false when content is null or the laid-out set is empty; every node must have positive height and satisfy offset <= top and top+height <= offset+windowRows, with top summed from the node up to but excluding the content root; a node outside the root yields -1 and fails
behavior.overlap: _ne is true only when both lists are non-empty and no content plugin appears among the plugins
behavior.paneKeys: vFe binds pane:scrollUp/Down to scrollBy(-1/1), pageUp/Down to -/+bodyRows, top/bottom to -/+contentRows; pne spreads the bindings, then the scroll handlers, then (outside inputs only) replaces pane:scrollUp/Down with abovePrompt:previous/next
behavior.constants: wne is 5 (collapse handle columns); vne is 150 (row settle debounce, ms)

product.seam: plugin-chain-above-prompt.ts exposes paneWindow, autofocusIndex, promptContextName, hotkeyBindings, nodeTopWithin, cueFullyDrawn, pluginsOverlap, scrollKeyHandlers, paneKeyBindings, COLLAPSE_HANDLE_COLUMNS and ROW_SETTLE_DEBOUNCE_MS
